## Task 4 – The menu

**In your workspace**, in the chunks of Task 4 of `index.qmd`. Try the reference specification and three or four others, changing one argument at a time. Then rerun the one that you would defend and send it with `submit_exploration()`. Your mark is drawn on the class chart as an open circle.

[Open the deck at Task 4](../../live/day.html#/hands-on-4-work-the-menu){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 4](../../lab.qmd#task-4-menu){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

## The class results and your placement

[Open the class results](../../class-results.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Find your own mark among the exploratory results of the class. Then rerun `try_spec()` in your workspace with the choices that you submitted, or in the cell of the slide [Your own placement](../../live/day.html#/find-your-own-percentile){target="_blank"} of the deck, and read your placement, which is the number of the 64 specifications whose gap lies further below zero than yours. Send it in the chat when the facilitator says go.

## Task 5 – The preregistration

**In the preregistration block of your report**, the chunk `prereg` of `index.qmd`. Complete the block before you run anything, render the report, and type "declared" in the chat. When the class has declared, fit the specification with `run_spec()` and send it with `report_result()`. Your declared result is drawn on the chart as a filled circle beside the open circles of Task 4.

[Open the deck at Task 5](../../live/day.html#/the-preregistration-moment){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 5](../../lab.qmd#task-5-preregistration){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

If your installation fails, complete the block in the deck or in the browser lab, and copy the completed cell into your notes instead of rendering.
